model.cdc_marketing.int_marketing_ads_st.name: int_marketing_ads_stats
model.cdc_marketing.int_marketing_ads_st.description: Cross-platform daily ad performance stats. Snapchat country-level data is aggregated to ad + day so both platforms share the same grain. Grain: one row per platform + ad_id + date.

model.cdc_marketing.int_facebook_ads_det.name: int_facebook_ads_details
model.cdc_marketing.int_facebook_ads_det.description: Facebook ads joined with their ad group, campaign and account. Grain: one row per ad_id.

model.cdc_marketing.int_snapchat_ads_det.name: int_snapchat_ads_details
model.cdc_marketing.int_snapchat_ads_det.description: Latest version of Snapchat ads joined with their ad group and campaign. Grain: one row per ad_id.

model.cdc_marketing.fct_marketing_perfor.name: fct_marketing_performance
model.cdc_marketing.fct_marketing_perfor.description: Unified marketing performance fact table. Combines Facebook and Snapchat daily ad metrics with key descriptive attributes and standard KPIs (CTR, CPC, CPM). Grain: one row per platform + ad_id + date.

model.cdc_marketing.stg_facebook_ads_bas.name: stg_facebook_ads_basic_all_levels
model.cdc_marketing.stg_facebook_ads_bas.description: Cleaned daily performance metrics from Facebook Ads. Grain: one row per ad_id + ad_date. Dirty string values such as 'null' are converted to real NULLs.

model.cdc_marketing.stg_snapchat_ads_adg.name: stg_snapchat_ads_adgroup
model.cdc_marketing.stg_snapchat_ads_adg.description: Cleaned Snapchat ad group history. Note: ad_group_id is not unique because the source contains historical versions. Latest version will be selected in the intermediate layer.

model.cdc_marketing.stg_snapchat_ads_sta.name: stg_snapchat_ads_stats
model.cdc_marketing.stg_snapchat_ads_sta.description: Cleaned daily performance metrics from Snapchat Ads. Grain: one row per ad_detail_id + ad_date + ad_country. This is a country-level breakdown of ad performance.

source.cdc_marketing.facebook_ads.ads_st.name: ads_stats

source.cdc_marketing.snapchat_ads.snapch.name: snapchat_ads_stats
